bug_semantics: In multi-team mode, Apache Airflow's Amazon Secrets Manager and SSM Parameter Store backends look up a Connection or Variable by first building the caller's team-scoped AWS name (`{prefix}/{team}--{id}`) and, on a miss, falling through to the team-agnostic name (`{prefix}/{id}`). A guard `if team_name is None and re.fullmatch(r"[^-]+--.+", secret_id): return None` was meant to refuse ids that already spell out a team namespace, but the `team_name is None` conjunct makes it a no-op whenever a team scope is supplied — exactly the authorized-caller case. A caller in team A who supplies id `B--secret` therefore misses `prefix/A--B--secret` and then reads `prefix/B--secret`, obtaining team B's credentials in full (CWE-639). No extra config is required beyond multi-team mode plus either backend. A related prefix collision (team `a` asking for `b--c` builds the same name team `a--b` builds for `c`) is the same user-controlled id, settled by the same fix.
flaw_origin: Multi-team path construction landed in #65395/#65396 as a single lookup with no second, team-agnostic fetch. #65703 member f2f9710 switched the separator to `--` and added the no-team-context guard; that tree still does one lookup. The next member, ff7c8eb1cdb59daf5e08eaf3819edb04cf491b09 (`added global fallback and updated docs`), split the AWS fetch and inserted the miss-then-agnostic fall-through while leaving the guard unchanged — the first write of the CVE mechanism. GitHub squash-merged the PR onto main as aa3ccb8c3c2cb7ce66d538e95c7681890965e654 with identical backend blobs. Parent f2f9710 has no `_get_secret_value` / miss-then-retry. #66059 only added log lines around the same guard. #70878 (0191b11) refuses any id containing `--` before either lookup.

reasoning: CVE-2026-68872 is a real, published CWE-639 in the Amazon provider: with multi-team mode, a team-scoped caller can name another team's namespace in the Connection/Variable id and, after the team-scoped AWS probe misses, the team-agnostic lookup returns that team's secret. The lifecycle is: #65395/#65396 introduced team path construction without a second fetch; #65703 member f2f9710 added `--` plus a guard that only fires when team_name is None; ff7c8eb then added the global fallback that the guard does not cover for a team-scoped caller.
